**Premise correction:** There is no GraphQL API in this repository — no `.graphql` schema files, no GraphQL library dependency, and no GraphQL-related code anywhere.

**Actual API surface:** The public API is defined via Protocol Buffers as gRPC/Connect services, with a REST/JSON surface auto-generated via grpc-gateway. Service definitions live in `proto/api/v1/*.proto` (e.g. `memo_service.proto`, `user_service.proto`, `attachment_service.proto`, `auth_service.proto`, `instance_service.proto`, `idp_service.proto`, `shortcut_service.proto`, `ai_service.proto`, `common.proto`). These compile to generated Go code under `proto/gen/api/v1/` (including `*_grpc.pb.go`, `*.pb.gw.go` for the REST gateway, and `apiv1connect/*.connect.go` for Connect-RPC), and TypeScript bindings under `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/`. The concrete handlers implementing these services live in `server/router/api/v1/` (e.g. `memo_service.go`, `user_service.go`), registered onto the HTTP server via `RegisterGateway`/`RegisterRoutes` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`).
